ic_device.name: TL431
ic_device.description: Three-terminal adjustable shunt regulator with specified thermal stability over applicable temperature ranges. Output voltage adjustable from Vref (approximately 2.5V) to 36V with two external resistors.

pins.name: ANODE
pins.description: Common pin, normally connected to ground
pins.evidence: Common pin, normally connected to ground

port_dependencies.condition: Cathode current (IKA) ≥ 1mA (Imin(max)) must be supplied into the cathode pin
Reference pin cannot be left floating, needs IREF ≥ 4µA

functional_blocks.name: Internal Reference & Amplifier
functional_blocks.description: Contains an accurate voltage reference and opamp. Forces reference pin to 2.5V when operated with enough voltage headroom (≥ 2.5V) and cathode current (IKA).

functional_blocks.name: Darlington Output Stage
functional_blocks.description: Darlington pair used to sink maximum current of 100mA.
